title: Factorify
description: Combination of lots of industrial-automation themed Mods.
body:
In this ModPack,\
you will automate, build,\
and create railway tracks for easy trasportation.

You will make your way through the progression of the MI Mod,\
and create electricity.

You'll surely want to download this ModPack because it offers:

- Fun progression
- Automation
- Electricity
- And much more!

Features:

1. Total control on automated machines
2. Cool progression system
3. Lots of tools for you to uncover
4. Power genaration
5. Trains

For any help or bug reports, join my discord using this link: https://discord.gg/C9b3anUaP9
